description: Traffic Lights Data Hamburg is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Transparenzportal Hamburg. LSA-Prozessdaten Der Datensatz umfasst momentan die LSA-Prozessdaten für rund die Hälfte aller am Verkehrsrechnernetz angeschlossenen Knoten in Hamburg und enthält aktuelle Signalausprägungen in Echtzeit. Zusätzlich werden Daten zu Detektoren wie Fahrrad-, Fußgänger- und Kfz- Anforderungen sowie Busmeldungen übertragen. Coverage: Transparenzportal Hamburg. The portal files it under the publisher Transparenzportal Hamburg. Its tags are ampeldaten, ampeln, echtzeitdaten, frost-server, geodaten. It offers 18 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
